name: S-360-48
description: 360W 48V budget switching power supply from Sompom. A cost-effective option for 48V 3D printer builds using TMC5160 or similar high-voltage stepper drivers. Shares the same chassis and feature set as the S-360-24 but with 48V output. Suitable for builders on a budget who want to experiment with 48V systems without investing in a MeanWell UHP or LRS unit.
